frame.goal: Keep the user's future question and make a provisional seed sketch before topical search.
completion: State scope, horizon and resources
Separate the user's observation, current facts and assumptions
Save a short capability/relationship sketch and the unknowns that could change its meaning

foothold.goal: Resolve only the factual ambiguities needed to understand the seed.
completion: Check capability, availability, scope and other consequential seed premises or retain them as assumptions
Stop when the seed is intelligible; defer market surveys and use-case narratives
Record incidental exposure to existing future narratives without claiming an unexposed first pass

diverge.goal: Explore different mechanisms before a deliberate topical survey, using scoped independent contexts when useful and available.
completion: Develop candidates beyond the obvious framing
Include changing wants, refusal and unfamiliar uses
Keep any search exposure visible; do not pretend learned priors were erased

research.goal: Find material that opens, changes or challenges a meaningful path.
completion: Retain claim-local sources and counterevidence
Seek enabling material and unfamiliar uses as well as failures
Omit peripheral statistics and label unread leads

recombine.goal: Use new material to change or refine the candidate mechanisms.
completion: Explain changed dependencies or actor responses
Distinguish refinement from a different route
Keep a candidate ledger: each initial candidate and returned exploration direction with its quoted core and state (developed, merged, transformed, or set aside with a reason)
Choose consequential open questions for development

pathways.goal: Save a pre-review pathway draft that integrates development results.
completion: Integrate performed evolution and contrast work without repeating it
Explain transitions, responses, feedback and branch-specific conditions
Carry each developed or merged ledger core as a concrete sentence, scene or branch, or change its row to set aside with the reason
Label this synthesis as pre-review; later corrections use a new revision

review.goal: Perform a scoped grounding and creative challenge; judge the reviewer's proposed repairs as candidate mechanisms.
completion: Give the reviewer neutral candidates, evidence and the ledger's set-aside candidates with their stated reasons
Save a full reply or an honestly labelled issue summary, stating context and coverage
Distinguish supported premise corrections from proposed causal repairs; register material issues and park unused peripheral leads

reconcile.goal: Finish the current pathway version and report, then account for every registered issue.
completion: Update or explicitly confirm the pathway synthesis after review and any follow-up work
Sweep the finished report's statements about the present and past for source, data period and edition, measure and read status; rewrite or remove unsupported ones before binding
Read the candidate ledger against the finished files; restore a lost core or record its state with a reason
Use a disposition and actual excerpt for each relevant target of a material issue
Distinguish unresolved conditions and unused leads from unperformed work

deliver.goal: Deliver the bound report and the current-version entry point.
completion: Include the report bound at reconciliation unchanged
State integrity, execution, review scope and semantic limits separately
Use 00-current.md to find the latest synthesis and historical versions

evolution.goal: Follow the world after explicit enabling assumptions hold.
completion: Follow an ordinary event, other responses and repeated use
Show a consequential change, feedback or alternative
Bridge back to the present and name the next worthwhile question

contrast.goal: Explain different choices in a comparable situation.
completion: State the compared situation, options and meaningful actor differences
Explain conditional choices and a change that reverses them
For commercial questions distinguish need, use, payment and capture; retain nonparticipation
